description: On Tuesday, July 12, an EPC (Turnkey) contract was signed in Dhaka at Hotel Sonargaon between Bangladesh-India Friendship Power Company Limited and Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited for the implementation of the Thermal Power Project in Rampal, Bagerhat.
